titulo: The inbox at eleven and three
caption:
The inbox at eleven and three

"Check it every minute." "Eleven and three." Six pings waited their turn, and the morning went quiet.

Two set times take the inbox off your back for hours, and nothing that truly burns waits for a reply.

For whoever opens the inbox at set times, not every minute.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table, a digital clock on the right that says 9:00 and a pile of sticky notes growing in the middle, one every moment. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes says check it every minute. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers eleven and three. The clock turns to 11:00, the notes vanish and the blue one's eyes go wide and says ...quiet morning. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me opening it at eleven and three.
